english.note: Use this when tailoring means narrowing the scope of a rule, law, policy, or similar measure to meet a particular need.

examples.english: The new policy will tailor the aid eligibility rules to focus on people who genuinely need help.
examples.traditional: 新政策會收窄援助資格，集中幫真正有需要嘅人。
